newsitem.title: USA: Delta increases summer flights from Atlanta.
newsitem.headline: Delta increases summer flights from Atlanta.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said Friday that it will have 611 daily departures at the Hartsfield Atlanta International Airport under its summer 1997 schedule.
The carrier said it now offers 587 daily departures from the Atlanta airport.
Delta said the summer schedule builds on changes that include an expansion of Delta's Atlanta Worldport.
"These moves to redeploy Delta's aircraft to the most productive routes for the company," the company said in a release. "We expect the changes to strengthen operating performance."
It said new flights include its first service to Brazil, which will begin on June 15 with flights to Sao Paulo and Rio de Janiero.
Delta said the start-up date is contingent upon the timely receipt of government approvals.
